description: Sends Nikita a company's brand guidelines for a video: links to the brand book, logo and font files, the brand colors and fonts, logo rules and tone of voice. Use it when the user wants VIDEO DEPT. to have their brand guidelines, usually with or after a brief. Links must be web addresses the user gives, for example Google Drive, Dropbox or the company's site. For files that aren't online, give the user a private upload link (get_upload_link), or they can email them to nikita@videodepartment.org. This sends the details to Nikita and can't be taken back: show the user exactly what you'll send and ask first.

colors.description: Optional: the brand colors, up to 8, each as a hex code with an optional name, like Navy #0A2342.

company.description: The company whose brand this is.

email.description: The user's work email, where Nikita can reply.

fonts.description: Optional: the brand font names, up to 4.

links.description: Up to 5 web addresses (starting with https://) of the brand book, logo or font files, exactly as the user gave them.

logo_rules.description: Optional: how the logo may and may not be used, in plain words.

notes.description: Optional: anything else Nikita should know, such as colors or music to avoid.

project.description: Optional: the brief number (like A-12), the quote number (like Q-12) or the project name this is for.

tone.description: Optional: the brand's tone of voice, in a few words.

name: send_brand_guide
title: Send the company's brand guidelines
